beats.story: I peel my crusted eyes open, wiping the residual tears away. It's not quite dark in my living room, but the sun has given up for the day. I remember putting on Schitt's Creek, pouring alcohol into me, and letting the bitterness creep in. Bitterness about everything that's ever happened until my brain and body couldn't take anymore. I pull myself up from the musty couch that has been soaked in misery, every muscle and joint sore from my void slumber, from the heaviness in my chest. I'm still in my stiff work pants. I somehow managed my shirt off but not my bra, so it's all twisted. I push the half-empty wine bottle onto the far end of the couch, where it'll stay put for later.
beats.story_cn: 我糊住的眼皮勉强睁开，抹掉眼角未干的泪痕。客厅里还没有完全暗下来，但太阳今天已经投降了。我记得自己点开了《富家穷路》，把酒倒进喉咙，任由苦涩一点点漫上来——对过往一切的苦涩，直到意识与身体双双崩溃。我从这张浸满愁苦的霉味沙发上撑起身，每块肌肉、每个关节都在隐隐作痛，来自虚空中的昏睡，也来自胸口沉甸甸的压迫。身上还穿着硬邦邦的西裤。不知怎么竟脱掉了衬衫却忘了解胸衣，此刻全都拧绞在一起。我把喝剩半瓶的酒推到沙发最远处，留待稍后再饮。

beats.story: I slide out of my pants and leave them on the floor as I stumble to bed. My eyes fall closed and heavy as I wait for the void to give me mercy and take me away again. They were right about me. The next time I wake, I check my phone and see a few messages from my mom. She's talking about some DJ she's booking for the party at a steep discount that her third cousin says is best. I guess Armin hasn't said anything yet. I text her, That sounds good, and toss my phone on the floor. I peel back a curtain to check the time of day.
beats.story_cn: 我褪下滑落在地的裤子，踉跄走向床铺。眼皮沉重地合上，等待虚空再次施以仁慈，将我吞噬。他们说对了。再次醒来时，我看手机发现妈妈发来几条信息。她正谈论为派对预订的一位DJ，说是她三表亲推荐的，价格格外优惠。看来阿明还没提起那件事。我回复“听起来不错”，把手机扔到地上。我掀开帘子瞥了眼天色。

beats.story: Outside my window, Miley is sitting on the stoop. Her gaze shifts to my window as she notices the curtain move, but she stays in place. I'm too numb, too distant, to feel anything. "Go inside," I say to my closed window. "Nobody's coming to talk to you." My phone chimes several times as I disappear under my covers and drift into another dreamless slumber. Day two, I have instant coffee and search for jobs from bed. There's no market for a socially fucked-up administrator anymore. I could never do an interview anyway.
beats.story_cn: 窗外，麦莉坐在门廊上。目光瞥见窗帘微动，她抬眼望来，但仍坐在原处。我麻木而疏离，感受不到任何情绪。“回去吧。”我对着紧闭的窗户说，“没人会来找你说话。”手机接连轻响几声时，我已钻进被窝，再次坠入无梦的昏睡。第二天，我喝着速溶咖啡，在床上浏览招聘信息。这个市场早已不需要社交残废的行政人员。反正我也根本没法参加面试。

beats.story: I can't leave this apartment. Maybe I could live here until the money runs out and they send me away somewhere in the countryside. I order fried chicken and wash it down with gin. Outside my window, Miley is tying two balloons to the streetlamp. Beside her sit two of her demented crochet figures. There she sits, still not broken from it all. I should do something for her birthday. Later, I'm drinking and watching another early 2000s comfort show from the same spot on my bed, when I hear a commotion outside.
beats.story_cn: 我没法离开这间公寓。也许我就该待到积蓄耗尽，被他们扔去某个乡下地方。我点炸鸡外卖，用琴酒往下灌。窗外，麦莉正把两只气球系在路灯上。她身边蹲着两个疯疯癫癫的钩针玩偶。她就坐在那儿，竟还没被这一切击垮。该为她的生日做点什么。后来，我喝着酒，在床上老位置重温本世纪初的治愈老剧，忽然听见外面一阵骚动。

beats.story: I check through the window and see two girls Miley's age standing by the streetlamp. Miley runs out and talks to them, a bounce in her step. I pull the windowpane up an inch. The girl on the left's voice carries. "This place is gross. I don't want to sleep over here. Come on, let's go." Miley mutters something, but they walk away anyway. She walks over to the bench and collects the crochet figures she placed earlier.
beats.story_cn: 我隔着窗户张望，看见两个和麦莉同龄的女孩站在路灯旁。麦莉跑出去和她们说话，脚步雀跃。我把窗框往上推了一寸。左边女孩的声音飘进来："这地方脏死了。我才不要在这过夜。走啦，咱们别待了。"麦莉低声嘟囔了句什么，她们还是离开了。她走向长椅，捡起先前摆放的钩针玩偶。

beats.story: Her shoulders drop in a way I recognize too well. Finally, she turns toward the stairs, the bounce in her step gone, face torn. A hallway door slams as I take another big drink. I should say something. I should want to hug her or to comfort her in some way. But all I keep thinking is: Finally, you see what it's like. It stays that way forever. But tears fall from my eyes for no reason, confusing and foreign.
beats.story_cn: 她垮下肩膀的姿态我熟悉得刺痛。她终于转身走向楼梯，脚步再无雀跃，面容扭曲。走廊门砰地关上时我又灌了一大口酒。我该说些什么。该想拥抱她或用什么方式安慰她。但我满脑子只剩一个念头：终于，你也体会到这种滋味了。这种感觉永远如影随形。泪水却莫名涌出眼眶，陌生得令人困惑。

beats.story: I don't need them. I can't feel them in a way that matters. My phone chimes over and over. I never check it, and eventually the chiming stops. I fall asleep and know that there's nothing inside me. I'm a hollowed-out void. The next days are the exact same. Nothing at all happens, and I am alone. I'm only pretty sure I'm disappearing.
beats.story_cn: 我不需要他们。我也感觉不到他们真正的存在。手机一遍遍响起，我从不查看，铃声终会自己停歇。我入睡时，清楚地知道心里空无一物。我是一个被掏空的虚无。接下来的日子毫无二致。什么都没发生，我独自一人。我几乎能确定自己正在消失。
